Describe the spatial understanding this image supports: the layout of the scene; which people and objects are present and roughly how far each is from the camera wearer (in metres) and from each other; relative positions (left/right/in front/behind, above/below); which way people face and whether they look toward the camera wearer; what is within arm's reach of the camera wearer or of others; occlusions and anything partly out of view; and how these change across the 5 frames (approach, retreat, turning). Describe only spatial facts. Do not guess anyone's intentions, social norms, or what anyone should do. Return only JSON: {"rgb": "..."} with 4-6 sentences.

descriptions.rgb: The scene is set on a narrow, wet tiled walkway bordered by low walls and railings on both sides, with the camera wearer looking downward at a high angle. In the first two frames, a person in a fuzzy dark blue sweater stands immediately to the left and in front within 0.5 metres (arm's reach), extending an arm toward a person in a bright green jacket standing about 1 to 1.2 metres ahead who faces the camera wearer and holds scissors and green wristbands within reach of the first person's wrist. In the second frame, the camera wearer's own hands holding a vertical black umbrella shaft at 0.2 to 0.3 metres and a black canopy above partially occlude the person in the dark blue sweater, who faces forward-right away from the camera wearer. From the third to the fifth frame, the camera wearer turns the viewpoint leftward along the walkway, causing the person in green to leave the right edge of the frame while the person in the dark blue sweater shifts to the right foreground at 0.5 to 0.8 metres, facing right with their back and black backpack toward the camera. This turn reveals a person in a bright blue hooded jacket and pink backpack about 0.8 to 1.2 metres to the left, facing right and not looking at the camera wearer, alongside three other people standing further back along the walkway between 1.5 and 3 metres away whose upper bodies are partly cut off by the top frame edge. In the fourth and fifth frames, the person in the bright blue jacket crouches down to bring the wet floor and a small green piece of paper within their arm's reach, then begins rising while holding the paper in front of them, with the camera wearer's hands remaining visible at the bottom edge.
